title: André Gustavo Moutinho
text:
Hey there! I’m André (or Gustavo, I go by both). I’m a data builder working across different stages of the data lifecycle: Ingestion, Transformation, Delivery.
I’ve built custom ETL libraries, and dashboards for end users, web pages in django, and Flask APIs to communicate between different services! My passion is Mathematics and I enjoy building data inference, like risk simulation, time series forecasting, and classification (regressions, trees and neural networks).
You can check a detailed history of my accomplishments at Experience.

text:

Migrate data pipelines to dbt while supporting the original pipelines
Contributed to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) development and deployment

Built scalable data pipelines using Python (MongoDB → PostgreSQL → Tableau)
ML developments: Measuring significant User Satisfaction Feedback, Predicting User Satisfaction with Linear Regression
Tableau SysAdmin
Led internal Tableau Community self-service initiative







December 2019 - July 2022 (2 years 8 months)

Lead Data Analytics team
Grow people by investing in documentation and cross team collaboration
Research and build new solutions: Event driven data pipelines with webhooks, Django forms, human in the loop workflows




January 2018 - December 2019 (2 years)

Build custom data solutions: Python, Flask, Microstrategy, SQL
Manage largest customers
Shape team best practices: version control (Git + TFS), CI/CD (Jenkins)




September 2016 - January 2018 (1 year 5 months)

Build and support data pipelines with Python+SQL.
Refactor 10s of P&L reports from Samba shares to 100s of API uploads: faster, better access control, less maintenance overhead





October 2015 - June 2016 (9 months)

Developed time-series prediction models for river flow to optimize electricity production.
